author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: Fixes from a review of 2.4.2. A sample without free chlorine or pH no longer advances LastMeasurement: 2.4.2 kept the previous readings when a value was missing, so a rule or dosing app triggered by LastMeasurement could act on the previous sample's free chlorine. A refresh token that Cognito rejects three polls in a row now switches the refresh login off until the app is saved. A response without latestMeasureTime no longer flips cassetteType, and partial responses no longer cause false recovery notices followed by re-alerts.
